Layered Audio ooRexx v0.14 - real paired-camera acoustic-scene validation

User-supplied validation media (not redistributed):
- 1000053605.mp4
- 1000053603.mp4

User-provided geometry:
- both cameras are on the same physical mount
- cameras point in opposite directions
- each contributes approximately two minutes here
- recording timelines are not assumed aligned

Observed media properties:
- both containers: duration reported by ffprobe 119.940 s
- audio: AAC, mono, 16000 Hz, stream start 0.000 s
- video: H.264, stream start 0.000 s

Acoustic alignment probe:
- audio decoded externally for validation only; this does not become a Layered Audio runtime dependency
- speech-band (150-5000 Hz) RMS envelope, 20 ms hop
- normalized cross-correlation searched over +/-20 s
- strongest global peak: +5.32 s under the convention that CAM-3605 scene time is its local time and CAM-3603 scene time = local time + 5.32 s
- normalized envelope correlation at strongest peak: approximately 0.556
- nearby alternative peaks include approximately 4.68 s, 5.94 s and 6.44 s

Assessment:
- +5.32 s is retained only as a moderate-confidence alignment hypothesis
- nearby peaks mean it is not treated as exact synchronization
- no clock drift is asserted from this sample; affine scale remains 1.0 as a working mapping with drift assessment explicitly absent
- source recording timelines remain unchanged

The packaged deterministic regression uses the same 5320 ms mapping geometry to verify scene-time through-cuts across two independent AudioRecording objects. The user media are not included in the package.
